note: Verification case questions (synthetic material). Questions on a real case are case material and are kept outside the repository (default /mnt/owl-data/agent-coverage/questions-real.json, or LOUPE_AGENT_COVERAGE_REAL); the script reads both when the second exists. A graph entity has no page link an answer can cite, so the Significant layer questions do not require a citation. Expected answers were read from the live data read-only (SQL through the read-only psql helper and the app's GET endpoints) on the date above. The Verification case is written to by automated checks; counts of theories, notes and evidence there can move.
